notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-dcounters (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): Doubleword named counters: DEFINE / GET / QUERY / DELETE DCOUNTER with an 8-byte unsigned VALUE logged as hex, GET returns the value before the increment, QUERY does not advance, values past 2**31 and 2**32 kept exactly, a deleted counter is INVREQ RESP2 201. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: life
scenarios.why: GET / DELETE of a DCOUNTER that is not there (INVREQ 201), DEFINE VALUE(5), GET, GET, QUERY, GET, QUERY, DELETE, then GET and QUERY of the deleted counter (INVREQ 201)

scenarios.name: big
scenarios.why: DEFINE at 2**31-1, 2**32-1 and 5; GET across 2**31 and 2**32, QUERY, and GET with a doubleword INCREMENT of 2**32: values kept exactly (hex)

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: takes the EVALUATE/IF arm no crucible scenario reaches: a mode no WHEN names (falls through)
